dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings with sharp outer perimeters that transition from the dark background pelage into high-contrast light borders, enclosing darker interior centers; most prominent across the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid light-intensity punctate blobs lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the anterior cervical region and interspersed between larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A cluster of three primary macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank forms a visible scalene triangle, while a sequence of four smaller high-intensity blobs forms a linear arrangement parallel to the dorsal midline.
